audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers read Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Skill. The packet levelChart reads Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Skill/Dr. Mundo, and the mirror audit has already moved Level 6 and First item to Olaf and 2+ items to Dr. Mundo on the opponent's page.
audit.why: whys[2] 'close trades go to skill' is a Skill row marked Olaf; whys[4] and whys[5] describe your dive and item spike but were marked Skill; whys[6] 'the drain-tank reclaims the lane' is a Dr. Mundo row marked Skill. Rows 4-6 follow the mirror (already on disk); rows 2-3 follow the packet, which the whys support.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Dr. Mundo in BOTH layers as one atomic group, with ratings re-scaled and whys[3] and whys[5] re-pointed to their new rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was sold on Ragnarok making you 'unstoppable' against his peel, and the first-item stage on a generic Sundered Sky line. Neither is the actual spike.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo has no disables in his kit at all — Q slows, W is a damage-over-time burst with a conditional heal, E is an auto-reset, R is a heal. So Ragnarok's disable-immunity has nothing to bite on; what it gives here is armour and MR for 100/90/80s. The first-item spike is Grievous Wounds plus Black Cleaver against a champion whose whole kit is regeneration and stacked resistances.
audit.corrected: phases[4], phases[5], whys[4], spikes[1] and mid rebuilt on resists, anti-heal and armour shred.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction in this lane is absent everywhere: Heart Zapper only heals Dr. Mundo IF ITS BURST HITS SOMEONE. Walk out of its 325 range before the duration ends and he stores the damage but heals nothing. The page instead treats the W as an unconditional 'sustain spike + reset' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t. Separately, 'Ragnarok cleanses his Q slow' in whys[4], spikes[1] and mid is unsupported — Riot's text grants immunity to DISABLES, and whether that covers slows is not answerable from the data (the mirror flagged the identical claim as unverified).
audit.why: Riot text, Dr. Mundo W (17/16.5/16/15.5/15s, 325 range): 'stores a portion of damage he takes. At the end of the duration or on Recast, Dr. Mundo deals a burst of damage to nearby enemies. If the burst hit an enemy, he heals a percentage of the stored damage.' The conditional is explicit and it is free counterplay the page never gives. Also worth the player's attention: his passive resists the first IMMOBILIZING effect and drops a healing cannister — Undertow's slow is not immobilizing, so it will not waste that passive for your jungler.
audit.corrected: The heal condition and the 325 range stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, phases[4] and mid; every Ragnarok-cleanses-slow claim removed rather than reversed.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W-omnivamp' in mid. Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf W: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' The lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P), scaling with missing health.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heart Zapper's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still close through 4-5 — his sustain tightens it, and whoever respects E range and the Grievous Wounds windows takes it.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses his Q slow and lets you stick him through any peel for a guaranteed E true-damage burst he can't kite.
edits.after: Ragnarok's armour and MR let you sit on him through the Heart Zapper burst for a Reckless Swing his resistances cannot reduce.

edits.before: This is your strongest stretch — keep forcing short trades where W-omnivamp heals you back and Q-reset slows perma-stick him. The key is antiheal: rush Bramble Vest or Black Cleaver so grievous wounds cuts his passive and W sustain while Cleaver melts the armor he stacks. At 6, Ragnarok ignores his Q slow and lets you run him down for an E nuke through any tower peel — this is your dive window. Force kills now; every plate and grub you take is value he can't heal away.
edits.after: This is your strongest stretch — force short trades where the Tough It Out shield eats his Heart Zapper tick and Q-reset slows perma-stick him. The key is anti-heal: rush Bramble Vest so Grievous Wounds cuts his passive regen, and remember the W only heals if its burst catches you — leave the 325 range and he gets nothing. At 6 Ragnarok's armour and MR let you run him down for a Reckless Swing nuke. Force kills now; every plate you take is value he cannot heal away.

notes: UNVERIFIED and deliberately not asserted: whether Ragnarok's disable-immunity covers SLOWS. Riot's text says 'immune to disables' and nothing more, so all three claims that it cleanses Dr. Mundo's Q slow were removed rather than reversed — the mirror audit reached the same stopping point. Worth adding somewhere if a field opens up: his passive Goes Where He Pleases resists the first IMMOBILIZING effect and drops a healing cannister, and Undertow's slow does not trigger it, so it is still live for your jungler's gank.
